issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one operational GCP organization and billing baseline.

## Primary deliverable

One operational organization and billing baseline for the approved folder and project denominator.

## Verification result

Folder, project, billing-link, scoped-policy, administrative-group, budget, export, label, and ownership readbacks pass without changing unrelated POC resources.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one operational organization-and-billing baseline; individual folder project and policy changes are implementation parts.

## Dependencies

- GCP-B: #491

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every new project has corporate group ownership and cost attribution
- [ ] Policies are scoped and impact-reviewed
- [ ] Billing export and budgets are observable
- [ ] Existing POC resources remain unchanged unless explicitly admitted

## Owned paths

- `infra/gcp/organization/**`
- `docs/operations/cloud/gcp/organization-billing/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/gcp-c/**`

## PVF lanes

- `hierarchy-parity`
- `policy-impact`
- `group-ownership`
- `billing-export`
- `budget-and-label`

## Stop conditions

- A broad policy could affect POC resources
- Individual-only ownership remains
- Cost attribution is absent

## Non-goals

- Production activation
- GPU launch
- AWS organization changes
